description: Scrape any public web page as markdown, HTML, links, a screenshot or JSON. For fields from any page, send formats [{"type":"json","prompt":"..."}] or a schema; this needs an API key. For a site's own data, send its page URL with formats [{"type":"json","parser":"<name>"}] and the parser's inputs, such as page, in options. Some sites can only be read this way. Parsers: google: maps, maps-place, maps-reviews, trends, patents, ads, flights, hotels, play-app, play-search, play-reviews; upwork: search, job; craigslist: search, listing; careers: jobs, job; indeed: search, job; realtor: search, property; zillow: search, property; expedia: hotels; booking: search, hotel, reviews; airbnb: search, listing, reviews; youtube: search, video, transcript, comments, channel, post, playlist; reddit: search, post, subreddit, user, subreddits; instagram: post, profile, comments, transcript, feed; x: profile, community, post; threads: profile, post; pinterest: search, pin, board, profile; facebook: page, group, post, comments, marketplace; tiktok: video, comments, transcript, profile, hashtag, sound, search, ads, shop, followers, following, trending, live; linkedin: jobs, job, company, profile, posts, ads; meta: ads; amazon: product, reviews, search, bestsellers; ebay: search, item; appstore: app, reviews, search, top; trustpilot: company, reviews, search; yelp: business, reviews, search; tripadvisor: search, place, reviews; glassdoor: company, reviews, salaries; crunchbase: company; g2: reviews; luma: events, event; emails; phone: numbers; bsky: profile, post; link: in-bio; twitch: profile, clips; faa: airport-status; airport: security-waits; flightstats: flight, airport, airport-delays. Also takes onlyCleanContent, minAge, headers, skipTlsVerification, removeBase64Images, imageUrls, allMetaTags, blockAds, fastMode, storeInCache, lockdown, checkPromptInjection, redactPII, profile, zeroDataRetention. Free without a key, within limits; with a key, $1 per 1,000 pages; JSON, summaries and PDF text cost more, and a parser has its own price.

actions.description: Steps to run on the page before reading it, in order.

items.description: Objects with a type: wait (milliseconds, selector), click (selector, all), write (text), press (key), scroll (direction, amount, maxScrolls, selector), screenshot (fullPage, quality, viewport), scrape, executeJavascript (script), pdf (format, landscape, scale), perform (action).

excludeTags.description: CSS selectors to drop, such as .comments.

formats.description: What to return: names, or objects with a type. Default markdown.

anyOf.description: Objects with a type: changeTracking (modes, schema, prompt, tag), question (question), product, menu, screenshot (fullPage, quality, viewport), highlights (query, count), json (parser, options, schema, prompt, rules, checkPromptInjection), attributes (selectors).

includeTags.description: CSS selectors to keep, such as article.

linkStyle.description: none (default here) keeps link text only; inline keeps [text](address); numbered lists addresses at the end.

location.description: { country, languages } to read from. Default US.

maxAge.description: Oldest stored answer to accept, in ms. 0 reads live.

maxChars.description: Cut the markdown at this many characters; nextOffset says where to read on.

mobile.description: Read the page as a phone.

offset.description: Start this many characters in; send the last nextOffset.

onlyMainContent.description: Default true: leaves out menus, headers and footers.

proxy.description: auto tries basic, then enhanced if refused. Same price.

query.description: What you look for; a long page comes back as the matching passages.

timeout.description: How long to keep trying, in ms.

url.description: The page or PDF to read.

waitFor.description: Extra ms to wait before reading, up to 60000.

name: stophy_scrape
title: Web Scrape
